name: University Hospitals Cleveland Marathon
summary: The Cleveland Marathon started in 1978 and is held in May. It starts and finishes on St. Clair Avenue NE at Mall B in downtown. The route goes through Ohio City, Gordon Square, Edgewater and Lakewood, and includes long flat stretches.
courseHighlights: Start and finish on St. Clair Avenue NE at Mall B
Hingetown, Ohio City and Gordon Square
Long flat stretches from Lake Avenue to West Boulevard, then Edgewater
Two-mile Shoreway section, then a last mile on Detroit Avenue

paceStrategy.summary: The official page highlights long flat stretches, so even pacing works well. There is a Shoreway section on the way back and the course is subject to change because of construction.

segments.terrain: Downtown into Hingetown, Ohio City and Gordon Square
segments.advice: Start calmly; city streets are busy.

segments.terrain: Long flat stretches from Lake Avenue to West Boulevard and through Edgewater
segments.advice: Hold goal pace on the flat roads.

segments.terrain: Lakewood streets, turnaround at West 115th, two-mile Shoreway section
segments.advice: Stay steady; the Shoreway is a quiet, open road.

segments.terrain: Detroit Avenue through Ohio City and Hingetown to downtown
segments.advice: Use the crowds and finish strong.

fuelingNotes: The official page lists 17 water stops, with Gatorade and Gu on the course and e-Gel at three of the stops. Check the course maps page for exact positions.
tips: The marathon starts early on the Sunday of race weekend
The page warns that GPS distances may be off, because bridges create false elevation spikes
Gear check is at Mall B, near the start
Courses are subject to change because of construction, so check the official map

faq.question: Is the Cleveland Marathon flat?
faq.answer: The official page describes long flat stretches, but also warns that the course changes with construction. It does not publish a total elevation figure.

faq.question: When is the Cleveland Marathon held?
faq.answer: It is held on a Sunday in May.

faq.question: Where does the Cleveland Marathon start and finish?
faq.answer: Both are on St. Clair Avenue NE at Mall B in downtown Cleveland.
